title: Planet Brunei Reborn SMP
description: Planet Brunei Reborn, the No.1 Minecraft Server for Brunei. Updated for modern Minecraft and under new management.
body:
# Planet Brunei Reborn SMP

Planet Brunei Reborn (PBR) is a Southeast Asia-based Java and Bedrock economy network and the longest-running public Minecraft server in Brunei. 

PBR runs three servers:

- **Survival-SMP** — the main world, built around a curated content stack of progression, economy, seasons, raids, and town-building.
- **Minigames** — rotating minigame lobbies for quick sessions.
- **Vanilla** — a stripped-back survival world for players who want the classic experience without the custom content.

## Why join
- No Toxic Policy
- Full Bedrock Edition support 
- An established community with an active Discord, regular in-game events, and a multi-season history.
- No client-side mods are required to play. Everything listed above runs server-side.

## How to join

The Java address is shown on this project page. Bedrock players can connect using the same host and the Bedrock port shown in the project details. Join the Discord (linked in the external links) for rules, event schedules, and support.
